Viral Metagenome Workflow

Hover over or tab to a stage for details. Click it to open the walkthrough.

Stage 1 of 10Get Reads

Start with FASTQ files from your sequencer or the SRA.

SRA accession or sequencer output→raw FASTQ
ToolsSRA Toolkit
Open the Get Reads walkthrough →
Stage 2 of 10QC & Trim

Assess read quality, trim adapters, and filter low-quality sequences before assembly.

raw FASTQ→clean reads
ToolsfastpBBDukFastQCMultiQCTrimmomatic
Open the QC & Trim walkthrough →
Stage 3 of 10Assembly

Assemble short reads into contigs for downstream viral identification and analysis.

clean reads→contigs
ToolsMetaSPAdesMEGAHIT
LegacyIDBA-UD
Open the Assembly walkthrough →
Stage 4 of 10Viral ID

Detect viral sequences from metagenomic assemblies using diverse detection strategies.

contigs→viral contigs
ToolsgeNomadVirSorter2VIBRANT
LegacyVirSorterDeepVirFinderMARVEL
Open the Viral ID walkthrough →
Stage 5 of 10Quality & vOTUs

Assess genome quality and completeness with CheckV, then de-replicate contigs.

viral contigs→vOTUs
ToolsCheckVvclust
Open the Quality & vOTUs walkthrough →
Stage 6 of 10Taxonomy

Assign taxonomic labels to viral sequences using gene-sharing networks.

vOTUs→taxonomic assignments
ToolsvConTACT3geNomadVIRIDICCAT/BAT
LegacyvConTACT2
Open the Taxonomy walkthrough →
Stage 7 of 10Host Prediction

Predict the prokaryotic hosts of viral sequences using sequence- or signal-based methods.

vOTUs (+ host genomes or MAGs)→virus–host links
ToolsiPHoP
LegacyWIsHHostPhinder
Open the Host Prediction walkthrough →
Stage 8 of 10Annotation & AMGs

Annotate gene functions; identify auxiliary metabolic genes.

vOTUs→annotated genomes, AMGs
ToolsDRAM-vPharokkaprodigal-gv
LegacyProdigalVIGACenote-Taker 2
Open the Annotation & AMGs walkthrough →
Stage 9 of 10Abundance & Ecology

Map reads back to viral references to estimate genome abundance and population dynamics.

vOTUs + clean reads→abundance tables
ToolsCoverMBowtie2PropagAtE
LegacyRead2RefMapperBowtieBatch
Open the Abundance & Ecology walkthrough →
Stage 10 of 10Visualize & Explore

Explore and visualize viral networks, community structure, and genomic context.

networks, tables, annotations→figures
ToolsCytoscapeAnvi'o
Open the Visualize & Explore walkthrough →

This workflow goes from raw reads to annotated and classified viral populations in two parts:

  1. Reads → vOTUs (stages 1–5)
  2. vOTUs → Taxonomy, Host Prediction, Annotation and Abundance (stages 6–9, in any order)
